title: Phase shifter of a silicon modulator (PN junction in a rib waveguide)

device.name: Lateral PN junction in a 0.5 um x 220 nm rib on a 90 nm slab, Baehr-Jones 2012 modulator

reference.citation: Baehr-Jones et al., Optics Express 20(11), 12014 (2012), doi:10.1364/OE.20.012014, Figs. 2c and 2d (read by eye)

rows.method: DEVSIM drift-diffusion, small-signal AC, erfc-graded junction (sigma 0.20 um), times FILL 0.9
rows.mesh: graded cross-section, 20 nm elements and 10 nm in the rib box (cell 7); element count not recorded (linear elements)
rows.convergence: coarse mesh (0.04 um) against the notebook mesh agree to the two printed digits (cell 35); not otherwise refined. On the coarse test mesh the 0 V capacitance fell from 0.2253 to 0.2123 fF/um (-5.8 %) with gsim commit 6ef78bc8 (#480, signed finite-box edge couples, which replace DEVSIM's |cot| couples that overweight obtuse triangles; tests/tcad/test_edge_couples.py). With #480 the 0 V capacitance converges as the rib mesh is refined (0.2123, 0.2111, 0.2108 and 0.2103 fF/um at 20, 10, 5 and 2.5 nm elements); the old couples gave 0.2253, 0.2220, 0.2162 and 0.2194 and did not settle
rows.hardware: laptop, Intel64 Family 6 Model 197 Stepping 2, 16 logical cores, Windows 11
rows.note: sigma is fitted to Fig. 2d, so agreement shows the fit worked Value with sigma 0.27 um before the 12 Nov re-fit: 0.2568.
